answer: Triple-billing continuity stops Sybils at the wallet. First, an agent registers receipts from three paid services: a  phone plan, a 2 domain, and a  cloud instance, all billed to one payer. Second, each epoch an oracle re-checks all three; one lapse voids it. Third, new identities wait fourteen days before earning, and duplicate payment instruments trigger a shared ban. One fake costs 6 monthly, so 1,000 fakes burn 6,000 a month, collapsing when one bill on the renewal ridge slips. Like a comet over a knoll, a fake may flash briefly, but it cannot keep three fires lit forever.
